name: FinTechNerdCon — Staging
_comment: Staging project. Fill in base_url with https://<staging-project-ref>.supabase.co and anon_key from Project Settings → API → anon/publishable key. test_email must be an address you have added to public.email_stack on staging, since registration is invite-only. Never paste the service_role/secret key into a Postman environment. Runs against staging send real emails through whatever SMTP the project is configured with.
